General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Instrument Cluster for Samurai SJ413.
This is a NEW Instrument Cluster
NOTE: This New OEM Cluster originally indicated speed by KPH but has been converted to MPH. The MPH Indicator Cover we applied shows the resting MPH Needle at 3 MPH.
Replaces Tach & Non-Tach Instrument Clusters.
May require mechanical wiring changes. Verify prior to purchase.
Fits the Round Vent type dash ONLY (85′ – 88′)Will not fit the 88.5′ – 95′ Models.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Instrument Cluster/Speedometer (Only Fits Samurai’s with Dash’s That Have Round Air Vents)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1988 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1988 All Models
